descriptions.preferred: Several green-leaved dissectums of good form are sold under this cultivar name. All of them have deeply dissected green foliage and form vigorous, strongly cascading shrubs of typical broadly mounded shape, Acer reaching up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. The green summer color turns to gold, often red, in the fall. The name means "green."

sources.title: 翠绿枝垂 Acer Palmatum 'Viridis'
sources.description: 翠绿枝垂枝条柔软，分支能力强。 春天是明亮的黄绿色，夏季是一种成熟的浓绿色，秋季色彩呈现金色橙色或者深红色。 叶裂一般呈现 7-9 裂，每个叶裂都靠基部连接。生长较为缓慢，成年 树高 1.5m，冠幅 1.5 米左右 ， 非常适合种植在庭院和池塘边，营造静谧的氛围感。

rhs.description: A low, spreading habit and specimens are often multi-stemmed. The leaves are so dissected as to appear almost shredded. Although green through the spring and summer they show good autumn colour. Red flowers are a discrete attraction in spring. These develop into winged fruit, typical of the genus

attributes.suggested_uses: Cottage/Informal Garden, Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture, drying winds or late spring frost. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt and a canker

descriptions_zh.preferred: 市场上有数个叶形优良的绿叶羽裂类品种以此名称出售。它们都具深裂的绿色叶片，形成生长旺盛、强烈下垂的灌木，树形为典型的宽圆拱丘状，高可达 13 英尺（4 米）。夏季绿色叶色至秋季转为金黄色，且常带红色。其名称意为“绿色”。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤缺水、干燥风或晚春霜冻都可能导致叶片焦枯。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病和溃疡病。

rhs_zh.description: 植株姿态低矮开展，常为多主干。叶片裂得极深，几乎呈撕裂状。春夏季保持绿色，但秋色表现良好。春季开的红色花虽不张扬，却别具观赏性；随后结成本属典型的翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Viridis' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Viridis' Weeping Green Viridis Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Viridis' is a classic dwarf green Japanese maple selection with a cascading form. The 'Viridis' Japanese maple can reach 5-6 ft tall by 5-6 ft wide in 10 years. This 'Viridis' laceleaf Japanese maple leafs out as a bright chartreuse green that holds until the leaves mature to a rich green by mid-summer. In autumn, the 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree turns to a bright golden yellow to orange. This classic 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree is excellent to provide contrast against red Japanese maples. You can use 'Viridis' as a background plant or as a focal point planting. Because of the dwarf cascading habit of 'Viridis', this Japanese maple makes an excellent tree for small space in the landscape or even for container planting. This can allow you to expand your garden with the beauty of a weeping green laceleaf Japanese maple. After years of observation, we believe ‘Waterfall’ and ‘Viridis’ to now be the exact same cultivar in the nursery trade today. The original ‘Waterfall’ was likely a ‘Viridis’ that happened to be at waterfall at a state park in New Jersey. We still sell both cultivars as both are popular names people know this selection by. 10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS
